messages:
Amira: Quick design check — trying a "priority thermometer" visual for the routing policies editor. Vertical bar that shows relative rule hit rate / traffic share. Idea is to make ordering more intuitive. Thoughts before I push comps?
Chris: Love the heuristic — low visual noise. Two quick calls: 1) needs strong keyboard focus states for the thermometer so users can reorder without mouse; 2) contrast for tiny bars will fail a11y, consider hatching or labels.
Sam: Figma frame: figma.com/file/PRIORITY-THERMO/thermometer — added 3 variants (color, hatch, numeric overlay). Also mocked micro-copy for empty state: "No rules matched — this policy won't route traffic."
Toni: One concern — simulation vs real traffic: the preview simulator needs to show sample size and last snapshot timestamp. Otherwise the thermometer could be misleading. Add small "sampled" badge?
Amira: Good call. Proposed copy for sample badge: "Snapshot (sampled 2k requests, last run 2h ago)" — comment on tone?
Chris: Put that badge next to the preview toggle. Also the run button should be primary: `Run snapshot` and we should disable it while sampling with a spinner.
Sam: Accessibility note: ARIA label for thermometer should read "Rule X — expected hit rate 24%" when focused. Also ensure hatch pattern is perceivable for colorblind users.
ui-lint-bot: a11y-check: contrast failures on variant 1 path-fill, missing ARIA on drag handles.
Amira: Ok let's prioritize fixes: (1) numeric overlay + hatch fallback (2) sample badge + last-run (3) keyboard drag handles + ARIA announcement. I can update the PR with copy edits.
Toni: One more micro-copy tweak for validation messages: instead of "Rule conflicts detected" use "This rule will never match because earlier rules take precedence" — clearer for non-experts.
Chris: Agree. Also in the preview sandbox, highlight the first matching rule with a pulsing outline for 2s when a snapshot runs — helps trace.
Sam: I'll update frames and export tokens for frontend. Tagging @chris for dev handoff.
Amira: Great — target to have updated comps by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:
